payload: Gamma Ray Observatory: 34,527 lb (about 15,700 kg) at the arm, the heaviest payload the robotic arm had moved, with four instruments (BATSE, OSSE, COMPTEL, EGRET); crew of five
credit: Sources: NASA JSC STS-37 Space Shuttle Mission Report (all clock times, GMT), NASA STS-37 press kit, NASA Compton page (end of mission). Not in the sources used: the clock time of the spacewalk and of the antenna failure. The report gives the first spacewalk as 3 h 30 min and the second as 5 h 47 min; Wikipedia gives 4 h 32 min and 5 h 57 min. Public domain / archive.

launch.source: NASA JSC STS-37 Space Shuttle Mission Report: planned circular orbit of about 243 nautical miles after the second orbital maneuvering burn. Launch from pad 39B

events.label: Launch — Atlantis from pad 39B
events.description: 5 April 1991 at 14:22:45 UTC (095:14:22:44.988 GMT) from pad 39B, after the countdown resumed about 4 min 45 s late at the T-9 minute hold because of weather limits. The second burn at 15:04 GMT left Atlantis in a circular orbit of about 243 nautical miles.

events.label: High-gain antenna stuck; spacewalk
events.description: On flight day 3 the arm raised the observatory and its high-gain antenna would not deploy. Shaking it with thrusters, then with the arm, failed. A contingency spacewalk began; the arm lowered the observatory and Jerry Ross shook the boom free early in the walk. The report gives no clock time for the antenna failure or the walk.

events.label: Observatory released by the arm
events.description: Released at 097:22:36:47 GMT, 7 April 1991, MET 2 d 8 h 14 min, three orbits later than planned (planned MET 2 d 3 h 35 min). It was the heaviest payload the arm had moved. A planned spacewalk on flight day 4 tested equipment and arm handling.

events.label: Landing at Edwards, a day late
events.description: Landing was delayed one day by high winds at Edwards, and fog closed the first Kennedy chance. Main gear touched down at 101:13:55:29 GMT, 11 April 1991, on lakebed runway 33 after a 221.4-second deorbit burn at 12:45:50 GMT. Flight duration 5 d 23 h 32 min 45 s.
